review_description: Quote was extremely informative. All questions were answered with knowledge making our choice easier. Rikky nad team installed a second PW2 for me a couple of months ago, which went very well. They did a great job, team was punctual, informative and did a very neat job, works flawlessly. The one last thing to be finished was the proactive bumper as the system is on an exterior hose wall with an integral carport. The original PW2 had a chunky bumper and the updated model was more compact. Rikky was great to offer to replace the original bumper with a new model so both batteries matched. The work was done this week, again, no issues, a great job and great service. Uploaded details include the original install in 2023 and the second PW2 in 2025

He visited the site a few times during this period to check in and answer my questions. Installation team led by Sean were brilliant; punctual, professional, friendly, very tidy and informative. Also very supportive and great teachers of the of the apprentices in the team. Always kept me informed and were very accomodating in completing a few extra requests. I had a few technical issues with network connections to the gateway and heat pump, but my requests for support were followed up same day with a site visit to sort everything. Price quoted includes heat pump and install, induction cooktop install, removal of gas heaters and cooktop and approx $2k of extra electrical work.I highly recommend the Exceed team.
